docs.text: VNM - Vietnam Dairy Products Joint Stock Company. Sector: Consumer Defensive. Industry: Packaged Foods.. Vietnam Dairy Products Joint Stock Company provides milk and dairy products in Vietnam and internationally. The company processes, manufactures, and distributes milk cake, soya and fresh milk, refreshment drinks, bottled and powdered milk, nutritious powder, and other milk products; and products for pregnant and infant, baby food, spoon yogurt, yoghurt and juicy milk drink, condensed and plant-based milk, ice cream, sugar, and cheese products, as well as nutritional products for adult. It is also involved in trading of food technology, spare parts, equipment, materials, and chemicals; trading in real estate properties, warehouses, and yards; owning or leasing land use rights; provision of internal transportation by cars for manufacturing and consuming company's products; manufacture, sale, and distribution of beverages, grocery and processing food, and roasted-ground-filtered and instant coffee; and manufacture and sale of plastic packaging products.

VNM - Vietnam Dairy Products Joint Stock Company. Sector: Consumer Defensive. Industry: Packaged Foods.. In addition, the company engages in the provision of healthcare clinic services; cattle raising and cultivation activities; and retail sale of milk and products from milk, bread, jam, candy, and products processed from cereal, flour, starch, and other food. Further, it processes beef products; sugar producing and refining activity; livestock raising and agricultural products trading; and manufactures, raises, processes, and trades in cattle and poultry products. The company was formerly known as Vietnam Milk Company and changed its name to Vietnam Dairy Products Joint Stock Company in November 2003.

VNM - Vietnam Dairy Products Joint Stock Company. Sector: Consumer Defensive. Industry: Packaged Foods.. Vietnam Dairy Products Joint Stock Company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

FPT - FPT Corporation. Sector: Technology. Industry: Information Technology Services.. FPT Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) and telecommunication products and services in Vietnam and internationally. It operates through Information Technology and Telecommunication; and Investment, Education and Others segments. The company offers internet services to individuals and households, as well as to enterprises, including internet leased line, domestic and international telecommunication, domain, hosting, web portal, and IPTV services; and online services for enterprises and individual customers, such as online newspapers and advertising, online music and payment services, and advertising systems.

FPT - FPT Corporation. Sector: Technology. Industry: Information Technology Services.. It also provides various IT products and services, including software production, digital transformation, IT system transformation, quality assurance testing, embedded software design, and ERP implementation and management services, as well as consultancy and deployment services based on S.M.A.C./Internet of Things technology; application software and information system integration services and solutions; data center, and networking and security system design services; warranty and maintenance of IT products; and IT equipment. In addition, the company offers software export, package and solutions, and related services; digital transformation and IT consulting, system management, BPO, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence and automation services; pay television and value added services; ADSL, line leasing, and online services; education services at primary, high school, college, university, and post-graduate levels, as well as online education services; and financial investment services. FPT Corporation has a strategic partnership with ZEBOX to develop and deploy AI-powered solutions for the transport and logistics industry.

FPT - FPT Corporation. Sector: Technology. Industry: Information Technology Services.. The company was formerly known as The Corporation for Financing and Promoting Technology and changed its name to FPT Corporation in December 2008. FPT Corporation was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Hanoi, Vietnam.

VCB - Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam. Sector: Financial Services. Industry: Banks - Regional.. Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam, together with its subsidiaries, provides banking products and services in Vietnam. The company accepts short, medium, and long-term deposits from organizations and individuals; sale of gold bars; and engages in financial and office leasing, and money remittance activities. It also provides account services; digital banking services; payment, corporate, and credit cards; consumer, home, auto, and business loans; and investment and savings insurance.

VCB - Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam. Sector: Financial Services. Industry: Banks - Regional.. In addition, the company offers money payment and cash flow management services, such as business accounts, cash flow management, trade finance, fund transfer, and corporate cards; SME loans, such as credit by industry, short, medium, and long-term loans; guarantee services; foreign exchange and capital market services, such as forex trading, interest rate derivatives, and commodity derivatives; digital banking; supply chain solutions; and consulting and investment services. The company was formerly known as Bank for Foreign trade of Vietnam. Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Hanoi, Vietnam.

HPG - Hoa Phat Group Joint Stock Company. Sector: Basic Materials. Industry: Steel.. Hoa Phat Group Joint Stock Company produces and sells steel products in Vietnam. It engages in financial investments; integrated investment in construction; exploration and exploitation of minerals, metal ores, sand, stones, and gravel; production of cast iron, steel, structural metal products, tanks, reservoirs, containers, plated and non-plated steel pipes, inox pipes, rolled steel, roofing sheets, galvanized steel sheets, color coated steel sheets, and galvalum steel sheets; production and trading of non-ferrous metals and metal scraps; trading and import-export of steel, iron, metals, metal ores, and steel-making supplies; mechanical processing, metal treatment, and coating; production, trading, and assembly of construction and mining machinery; leasing machines, equipment, and motor vehicles; dealing in automobiles, motorcycles, transport vehicles, and parts for transport and mining sectors; production, trading, assembly, installation, repair, and maintenance of electrical, electronic, optical, medical, household, and civil electrical appliances; manufacturing and trading of air-conditioners, refrigeration products, freezers, and refrigerators; production and trading of plastic products; civil and industrial construction; and construction of railway works. it is also involved in domestic and foreign investment advisory; advertising; general support services; raising livestock; provision of livestock raising services; processing and preserving of meat and meat products; production of animal feeds for cattle, poultry, and aquaculture; production of fertilizers and nitrogen compounds; trading agricultural equipment, machinery, and accessories; restaurants and mobile food service activities; provision of catering services; beverage serving services; coastal, inland waterway, and ocean transportation; and entrusted export-import activities.
HPG - Hoa Phat Group Joint Stock Company. Sector: Basic Materials. Industry: Steel.. Hoa Phat Group Joint Stock Company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Hung Yen, Vietnam.

VIC - Vingroup Joint Stock Company. Sector: Real Estate. Industry: Real Estate Services.. Vingroup Joint Stock Company invests in, constructs, and trades in real estate properties in Vietnam. It operates through Sale of Inventory Properties; Leasing Investment Properties and Related Services; Hospitality, Entertainment and Related Services; Health Care and Related Services; Education and Related Services; Manufacturing and Related Activities; General Contractor and Related Services; and Others segments. The company leases office and retail areas; operates hotels and resorts; manufactures and trades in automotive vehicles; and provides health care, education, general contractor, real estate management, information technology, real estate broker, and other services.

VIC - Vingroup Joint Stock Company. Sector: Real Estate. Industry: Real Estate Services.. The company was formerly known as Vincom Joint Stock Company and changed its name to Vingroup Joint Stock Company in April 2012. Vingroup Joint Stock Company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Hanoi, Vietnam.
